name: Tide Pools
description: Rock pools left by the tide, full of crabs, mussels and small fish. Big groupers wedge themselves under the ledges.

discovery.message: Below the path, the falling tide has left a scatter of shining rock pools.

pools.text: Warm, shallow pools between the rocks, bright with weed and darting fish. Mussels crust the ledges, and something large shifts under the biggest rock. Mind the crabs.

leave.text: You pick your way back up the rocks.
